about_the_game:
Legends say that out in the distant oceans, football is not just a sport – it’s a way of life. Explore life on the islands where sportsmanship and friendship pave the way for the future. Meet and compete against rivals and friends in Earth Legends.

Learn to master the true way of the ball – where every touch, every pass, and every strike is yours alone. Built on a groundbreaking physics system, the game puts destiny at your feet: no scripts, no limits – only pure football, shaped by your skill.

Play against the CPU to sharpen your abilities, or mix AI opponents with real-life friends for dynamic matches. Grab a controller, join forces or face off against each other, and experience football in its purest form. Choose your formations, create your own strategies, and prove yourself in matches where skill and creativity decide everything.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Arch Linux
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 2.0 compatible GPU
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Arch Linux
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 7600 / Intel i5 10th generation
  • Memory: 8000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon Intergrated or better, OpenGL 3.3+
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space
